player_prompt.intro:
Nek temɛḍqel {player_id} deg tesɛut n GameOfPureStrategy.
- Tekki 13 n yikarṭa A-K; each can be used once.
- Deg yal ṭṭufa, tawṛa n yikarṭa yettwabḍu. Sɛeḍ ṭṭafat yiwet s kan n yisem yettwaṭṭef s yisem yenṭaṭ like '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Akkarṭa ameqqran yettwassen tawṛa (maḍi d akkarṭa nniḍen). Tiṭṭafin tettwaxṭer ṭṭafat ad ṭṭafat n ṭṭufa.
- Akkarṭa ameqqran deg 13 n ṭṭufa yettwassen.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Taɣawsa ilaq ad tesεu yiwet n tkarḍa s teẓgi.
